mapper.insert: insert into item_review (order_id, item_id, user_id, seller_id, rating, content, images, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{userId}, #{sellerId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from item_review where item_id = #{itemId} order by create_time desc
select * from item_review where seller_id = #{sellerId} order by create_time desc
